001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.salvage;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.EveryFrameScript;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
005
006public class FleetAdvanceScript implements EveryFrameScript {
007        private CampaignFleetAPI fleet;
008
009        public FleetAdvanceScript(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
010                this.fleet = fleet;
011        }
012
013        
014        public void advance(float amount) {
015                fleet.advance(amount);
016        }
017
018        public boolean isDone() {
019                return false;
020        }
021
022        public boolean runWhilePaused() {

024        }
025}
